sites.name: Tomb of the Hollow Moon
sites.rumor: They say the eastern rift opens for four days in every twelve.
sites.discovery: A cold seam in the air widens where the rift breathes.

sites.name: Sunken Immortal Ruin
sites.rumor: A drowned hall surfaces west of the market when the qi tide turns.
sites.discovery: Broken pillars rise from the mist, still warm to the touch.

sites.name: Verdant Beast Realm
sites.rumor: Hunters speak of a green door that opens only when the beasts are restless.
sites.discovery: The undergrowth parts around a ring of claw-marked stones.

sites.name: Forgotten Battlefield
sites.rumor: On some nights the old war is still fought beyond the western ridge.
sites.discovery: A standard juts from the earth. The ground beneath it is still churned.

sites.name: Heavenly Garden
sites.rumor: A perfume no mortal flower makes drifts from the northern terraces.
sites.discovery: Jade steps descend into a garden that has not aged a single season.

sites.name: Abandoned Sect
sites.rumor: A sect hall south of the market still rings its bell, though no one answers.
sites.discovery: A gate stands open on a courtyard where every lesson stopped mid-sentence.

sites.name: Trial Realm
sites.rumor: The examiners left a trial standing east of the market. It still accepts candidates.
sites.discovery: A white platform waits at the end of a path that was not there yesterday.

sites.name: Spatial Fracture
sites.rumor: The western air folds in on itself. Do not walk the same path twice.
sites.discovery: Two horizons overlap in a shimmering seam, and the ground forgets which is nearer.

sites.name: Forbidden Domain
sites.rumor: There is a domain to the south whose name nobody will say aloud.
sites.discovery: A black gate opens onto a road with no shadow and no returning footprints.
